content.text: When Stripe restricts your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-what-actually-how-2|digital]] products in Zimbabwe, where traditional payment gateways are unreliable, your store's infrastructure must be more than just a workaround - it's a lifeline. Yet, even in restricted countries, you don't have to rely on Stripe or pay hefty fees for payment processing. With COREMERCH, you can choose from two options to deploy a digital store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-7|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]]-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-7|Cloudflare Workers]] Pages for free, without relying on Stripe or PayPal: Stack 01 or Stack 02. This post will delve into the differences between these two architectures, helping you make an informed decision about which one best suits your digital business needs.
What Each Option Actually Offers

Stack 01, the Sovereign Starter Stack, is a basic deployment on GitHub Pages, using Apps Script for backend logic and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. It allows you to deploy a digital store in 4-6 hours, following the Sovereign Blueprint, with 3 products loaded and 30-day support. On the other hand, Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack, is a more comprehensive architecture on Cloudflare Pages, utilizing Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. It offers a faster deployment in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing before handoff. Additionally, the Edge Commerce Stack provides 30-day support. While both options provide a robust digital store infrastructure, the choice between them ultimately depends on your business requirements and the level of customization you need.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, Stack 01 and Stack 02 handle them differently. Stack 01 is designed to work in countries where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or severely restricted, making it an ideal choice for digital creators in Zimbabwe and other similar regions. Stack 02, on the other hand, is also designed to work in restricted countries but requires COREMERCH's manual setup and deployment. This means that while Stack 02 can also handle restricted countries, it may not be as seamless as Stack 01. However, the Edge Commerce Stack offers more advanced features and customization options, making it a better choice for larger businesses or those with complex requirements.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, Stack 01 and Stack 02 have different offerings. Stack 01 uses NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, which charges a 0.5% fee. Stack 02 also uses NOWPayments, but it's integrated with Cloudflare Workers, which provides faster payment processing and lower fees. Additionally, the Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, which helps prevent email spoofing and ensures that your digital store's email communications are legitimate. In terms of real costs, Stack 01 is a one-time purchase of $97, while the Edge Commerce Stack is a one-time purchase of $197. While both options offer competitive pricing, the Edge Commerce Stack provides more advanced features and customization options, making it a better choice for larger businesses or those with complex requirements.
The Edge Commerce Stack offers faster payment processing and lower fees than Stack 01.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to ownership, automation, and delivery, Stack 01 and Stack 02 have different offerings. Stack 01 provides full ownership of the digital store infrastructure, with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery. Stack 02 also provides full ownership, but it includes more advanced features and customization options, making it a better choice for larger businesses or those with complex requirements. Additionally, the Edge Commerce Stack provides end-to-end testing before handoff, ensuring that the digital store is fully functional and ready for deployment.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture for your digital store depends on your business requirements and the level of customization you need. If you're a small business or individual creator, Stack 01 may be the better choice due to its affordability and ease of use. However, if you're a larger business or have complex requirements, the Edge Commerce Stack may be the better choice due to its advanced features and customization options. Regardless of which architecture you choose, COREMERCH's support team is available to help you every step of the way.
